mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 4.5% over three months indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, which precedes corporate earnings slowdowns and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.5% for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and retail sales signals broad-based consumer demand contraction, which reduces corporate revenue growth and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns in more than 40% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY growth > 3.5%), the Federal Reserve maintains restrictive policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances during CPIAUCSL YoY growth > 3.5% periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production indicates robust economic activity and corporate capacity utilization, supporting higher earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth fails to predict positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts below 1,100,000 units signals housing sector contraction, reducing consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where HOUST falls below 1100.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate and decline in nonfarm payrolls signals severe labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS decline and UNRATE increase fails to predict negative returns in more than 40% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 growth rate > 2.5% for 3 consecutive quarters), the economy approaches peak conditions, preceding corporate earnings slowdowns and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth rate > 2.5% for 3 consecutive quarters
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances during GDPC1 growth > 2.5% for 3 consecutive quarters.
